Nice finish to the over. A genuine play and a miss. Roach lands this on a length around middle, Jeet plays for it but then the ball moves away late to beat the outside edge.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Outside off, nice carry, left alone.
Pushes hard at this one and gets it off the inner half of the bat through square leg for a couple.
Outside off, left alone.
Short leg comes in play now.
A short ball outside leg, Raval arches away from the line and allows the cherry to hit his left shoulder. The ball balloons towards the slip cordon.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Good single. Waits for the ball to come to him and then taps it in front of cover. Calls for a single, the response is good and the fielder is a bit slow to respond.
Very full, almost gets it through, but Raval manages to bring his bat down in time to flick the ball towards square leg.
Gets it fuller and in line of the stumps, Raval pushes it towards short mid on.
Wider outside off, angling in, Raval watches it go past.
A length ball outside off, left alone.
Comes back in off the deck, TL is caught unawares and is hit on the pads. A maiden again from Roach but apart from that one ball in this over, not the greatest of maidens.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Finally a good ball from Roach. He lands this in the right area, closer to the batsman and the stumps, makes Tom play and then gets the ball to move away past the outside edge.
Goes wider of the crease and angles this away from the batsman, Latham is more than happy to let it go.
Fuller and in line of the stumps, watchfully defended.
Wide outside off, left alone.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Down the leg side again, clipped through mid-wicket. The ball does not have enough on it to reach the fence and three runs are taken.
Now this is on the pads and Tom clips it past mid-wicket for a brace.

FOUR! Uppish, but safe! The boundaries are flowing here. Full and outside off, Latham comes forward and drives it uppishly. However, it is just wide of the fielder and goes through to the long off fence!
FOUR! Nice way to get off the mark! A length ball, outside off, Latham just punches it past mid off and gets a boundary.

OOPSS! Finally West Indies get one right in the bowling channel. Gabriel keeps this between full and good but importantly it is in the line of the stumps. Raval is not sure whether to play or leave and has a nervous poke. As a result, the ball takes the inside edge and just goes past the leg stump towards fine leg. A single taken.
Another wide ball outside off, let through. A maiden for Roach but not that great an over.
One more leave outside off, too wide to be played at. Both the new-ball bowlers are wasting the cherry.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Full and wide outside off, let through.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A length ball outside off, left alone.
KEMAR ROACH to share the new ball with Gabriel.

FOUR! And this time on the leg side! Full on middle, Raval covers the line nicely for the inswing and pushes the ball past the bowler. Short mid on thinks he has a chance but cannot get there! Fantastic start for New Zealand. West Indies need to get the new ball in the right areas else, this will go away from them in the blink of an eye.
Full again, this time closer to the off stump, Jeet trusts the movement and lets it go.
FOUR! AMAZING! That will give Raval a lot of confidence. Half volley outside off, slightly wide, Raval comes forward and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Full on middle, very straight, swinging in, pushed towards mid on.

And some delay straightaway. Gabriel is not happy with the way he landed after bowling the previous delivery. Sawdust is being sprinkled near the landing area. Scott Styris on air informs that there was some rain overnight and hence the pitch has become a bit soft. All in readiness now.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and around off, Raval comes forward and pushes it towards cover.

The anthems are done and dusted and the players walk out to the middle. Jeet Raval and Tom Latham are the openers for the Kiwis. Shannon Gabriel to bowl with the new ball first up. Raval to face, with three slips in place. Here we go!
Time for the national anthems. As is the tradition, the visiting side's will be played first.

TEAM CHANGES - No changes in the paper after announcing the XI by New Zealand. It stays that Tim Southee comes in place of Matt Henry. Windies, too, have made just the one change - RAYMON REIFER makes his international debut in place of the suspended Holder.

TOSS - Well, not a bad start for the new captain. Kraigg Brathwaite has won the toss and WINDIES WILL BOWL FIRST. There is plenty of movement expected and utilizing the new cherry first up will be the key.

New Zealand had ticked most of their boxes in the first Test. If any, Williamson falling cheaply would be their concern. But the youngsters doing well and Neil Wagner coming of age would have pleased them to no end. They are so confident that they have announced their playing XI even before the toss, with TIM SOUTHEE replacing Matt Henry. Windies will like to keep us waiting for their playing eleven.

They were blown away in Wellington with just a simmer of a fight. To add to their woes, skipper Jason Holder has been suspended for this game. Will new captain Kraigg Brathwaite be able to instill any confidence in his group? The Kiwis, on the other hand are full of confidence. Newly become father, Tim Southee has added strength to their already strong arsenal. Another butchering on the cards? Perhaps. Hello and a warm welcome to the second of the 2-match Test series between New Zealand and Windies in Hamilton.
